subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity

Tom — great to meet last week on the call. We chatted internally and think Skybridge would be a strong candidate for an AWS ACE co-sell path. I wanted to kick off the operational piece so we can get ACE registration started and introduce our PDM/PSM teammates who will partner through the listing and co-sell stages.

Quick asks from our side to accelerate: 
- Confirm the AWS account used for Marketplace listing (if different from procurement@skybridge.ai).
- Provide an initial marketplace catalog name and one-line summary for the listing.
- Point person for legal/procurement (if you already have an intake contact).

I've attached a short ACE onboarding checklist to explain the steps. Looping in Aditya (sales ops) and Marissa (partner ops) to help with paperwork and timelines — they can own the registration upload and artifact collection.

Would you be available for a 30-minute wiring session next week to align on responsibilities and timeline? Proposed slots: Tue 9/20 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/21 11:00–11:30 PT. If those don't work, please suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACE-onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@skybridge.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Vega <elena.vega@skybridge.ai>
Date: 2028-09-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear next steps. Confirming a few items from our side: 
- Procurement contact is procurement@skybridge.ai (Elena CC'd).
- AWS account for listing is 1234-5678-9012 (we'll confirm with our cloud ops team tomorrow).
- Listing name suggestion: "Skybridge Conversational AI — Ops Suite" with a short blurb: "Low-latency, low-cost conversational inference for enterprise workflows."

Wed 9/21 11:00 PT works for me. I'd like to loop in a couple of engineers for the call to handle questions about artifact packaging. Also, could you summarize the co-sell benefit tiers and what triggers PDM involvement vs standard AE support? Procurement will want that for the vendor intake.

Tom
CTO, Skybridge AI
Tom.Alvarez@skybridge.ai

Date: 2028-09-19T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity

Tom — perfect, locked for Wed 9/21 11:00 PT. I added Rishi (our PDM) and Kimberly (PSM) to this thread so they can speak to technical and enablement requirements on the kickoff.

High-level mutual action items before the wiring session (I'll have Aditya track these in HubSpot):
1) Skybridge provides: AWS account number, short listing blurb, procurement contact, and a primary technical contact for artifact questions.
2) Redwood provides: ACE checklist + template artifacts, proposed listing SKU structure, and a co-sell benefits summary (what AWS requires, typical lead routing, and how we coordinate credits/discounts).
3) Timeline: target submission to AWS marketplace within 7 business days after the wiring session, assuming artifacts are complete.

Attaching the ACE onboarding checklist (quick walkthrough of artifacts and required screenshots). Aditya — can you confirm our preferred SKU template and whether we should propose a usage-based or subscription model for Skybridge's initial listing?

See you all Wed.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACE-onboarding-checklist.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@skybridge.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity

Tom / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few tactical notes before Wed's call: 
- Preferred SKU recommendation: start with a usage-based SKU (tokens/minutes) plus a small reserved capacity seat. We'll attach a sample price grid.
- Required artifacts for AWS listing (we'll collect during the session): product logo (png), one-line description, technical architecture diagram (PNG/PDF), pricing spreadsheet, and screenshots showing integration flows.
- Compliance: we will need a standard SOC2 status statement (if available) and a data processing contact for the contract.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/SALES-79 (I've created RINF-AWS-2028-79).
Proposed agenda for Wed 9/21 11:00 PT (30m):
  1) Introductions + roles (5m)
  2) ACE checklist walk-through (10m)
  3) Artifact ownership and deadlines (10m)
  4) Next steps + timeline (5m)

I've attached a sample pricing workbook and the AWS submission link for reference. If procurement needs to pre-read a co-sell benefits doc, send me an email and I'll share a one-pager.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Skybridge-PRICING-v1.xlsx, ace-registration-screenshot.png

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@skybridge.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-22T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — Skybridge AI opportunity

Tom / team — great meeting yesterday. Rapid recap and actions from PDM perspective: 
- We validated the artifact list and confirmed Skybridge's AWS account (1234-5678-9012).
- Action owner assignments: 
  * Skybridge: technical artifact package (engineers) — due 2028-09-28
  * Redwood (Aditya): pricing template submission and Marketplace upload assistance — due 2028-09-25
  * Redwood (Marissa): ACE registration intake form and compliance checklist — due 2028-09-24

Planned technical kickoff: 2028-09-29 10:00 PT (60m) — agenda will include integration testing, auth patterns, and latency profiling targets. I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-kickoff checklist this afternoon.

Co-sell note: to qualify for PDM-level joint engagement with AWS we usually need an initial listing submission plus one reference deployment with basic usage metrics (we can help scope what's acceptable).

Looking forward to partnering — attaching the pre-kickoff checklist for convenience.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Product Development Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-kickoff-technical-checklist.pdf
